560	Versed in the Act of Creation, meaning everything about the worlds of Tikkun before the Tikkun.	Versado no Maasê Bereshit, isto é, tudo sobre os mundos do Tikun antes do Tikun.
561	In the Act of the Chariot, which are the teachings after the Tikkun.	No Maasê Merkavá, que são os ensinamentos de depois do Tikun.
562	Versed in the speech of the trees: he knows what one tree says to another. Open Yevamot on Sukkah	Versado na conversa das árvores: sabe o que uma árvore diz à outra. Abram o tratado de Sucá,
563	28a, about Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai, who was versed in the speech of palms. Rav Hai Gaon writes:	página 28a, sobre Rabán Yochanan ben Zakai, que era versado na conversa das palmeiras. Rav Hai Gaon escreve:
564	Sometimes a wind blows, and one palm turns to its companion and shares a secret with it.	Às vezes há um vento, e uma palmeira se volta para a companheira e lhe conta um segredo.
565	Now, Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai knew what secret it revealed to him, and Rabeinu	Ora, Rabán Yochanan ben Zakai sabia que segredo ela lhe revelava, e Rabeinu
566	HaAri also knew what the trees say. Rav Hai Gaon was able to know the future by	HaAri também sabia o que as árvores dizem. Rav Hai Gaon sabia conhecer o futuro pelo	
567	the movement of the leaves in the wind. See what secrets have gone from us.	movimento das folhas ao vento. Vejam que segredos se foram de entre nós.
568	Versed in the speech of birds.	Versado na conversa das aves.
569	What is the speech of birds?	O que é a conversa das aves?
570	The Zohar writes that the raven, how it flies, how it moves, how it calls "kra, kra,"	O Zohar escreve que o corvo, como voa, como se move, como grasna "crá, crá",
571	all of it is hints and supernal secrets, and Rabeinu HaAri was versed in this.	tudo isso são indícios e segredos superiores, e Rabeinu HaAri era versado nisso.
572	In the speech of angels, that is, the seventy angels.	Na conversa dos anjos, isto é, os setenta anjos.
573	He knew the wisdom of physiognomy.	Conhecia a sabedoria da fisionomia.
574	The Zohar writes there: one who has large ears, one who has sunken eyes, one who has thick eyebrows, one	O Zohar escreve ali: quem tem orelhas grandes, quem tem olhos fundos, quem tem sobrancelhas grossas, quem
575	who has straight hair, one who has curly hair, one who has a thick beard.	tem cabelo liso, quem tem cabelo crespo, quem tem barba espessa.
576	Each thing hints at something else about a person.	Cada coisa indica algo diferente sobre a pessoa.
577	All this is in the Zohar. Open the Zohar.	Tudo isso está no Zohar. Abram o Zohar.
578	Zohar, in the Tikunim, page 121 side b; Zohar Chadash, page 39b onward; and also in Zohar Yitro,	Zohar, nos Tikunim, página 121; Zohar Chadash, página 39b em diante; e também no Zohar Yitro,
579	"You shall behold," page and side a onward.	"Tu contemplarás", página e lado a em diante.
580	And the whole Zohar there speaks of the greatness of the wisdom of physiognomy, astonishing things.	E todo o Zohar ali fala da grandeza da sabedoria da fisionomia, coisas assombrosas.
581	Rabeinu HaAri knew all the deeds of men, what they did and what they would do; he spoke with the winds,	Rabeinu HaAri conhecia todos os atos dos homens, o que fizeram e o que fariam; falava com os ventos,
582	he spoke with the birds, he would bring a person's soul while the person was still alive.	falava com as aves, trazia a alma da pessoa enquanto ela ainda estava viva.
583	He speaks with him, says to him: why are you lying?	Falava com ele, dizia: por que você está mentindo?
584	He says to him: but I am not lying, Rabbi.	Ele dizia: mas eu não estou mentindo, rabino.
585	He said to him: you're not lying?	Dizia: não está mentindo?
586	He takes out his soul, speaks with the soul, and says: the soul stands beside you and says	Tirava-lhe a alma, falava com a alma e dizia: a alma está ao seu lado e diz
587	that yesterday you did such and such.	que ontem você fez isto e aquilo.
588	How dare you be so brazen?	Como ousa ser tão atrevido?
589	He speaks with him.	Falava com ele.
590	And then he returns the soul to him. He would see souls at the time they left the body; he would go to the	Depois devolvia-lhe a alma. Via as almas no momento em que saíam do corpo; ia aos	
591	cemeteries and see all the souls sitting on the graves, and we checked after him once, twice,	cemitérios e via todas as almas sentadas sobre os túmulos, e verificamos depois dele uma, duas	
592	and three times: astonishing things not seen since the days of Rashbi. He spoke with the souls of the tzaddikim in the World to Come,	e três vezes: coisas assombrosas que não se viam desde os dias do Rashbi. Falava com as almas dos tsadikim no Mundo Vindouro,
593	and they revealed to him the secrets of the Torah. He would go to sleep at night and his soul would ascend, and the Prince of the Presence would ask	e eles lhe revelavam os segredos da Torá. Ia dormir à noite e sua alma subia, e o príncipe da Face lhe perguntava:
594	him: which yeshivah do you want to go up to? One day he would go to the yeshivah of Moshe Rabeinu, one day	qual yeshivá você quer visitar? Um dia ia à yeshivá de Moshe Rabeinu, um dia	
595	to the yeshivah of Rabi Akiva, one day another; and he would come down in the morning and remember everything he learned.	à yeshivá de Rabi Akiva, um dia a outra; e descia de manhã e lembrava tudo o que aprendera.
596	He knew the interpretation of dreams from their beds; he knew how many errors had crept into the books.	Sabia interpretar sonhos pelas camas; sabia quantos erros haviam entrado nos livros.
597	He would look at a book: you have 15 errors here.	Olhava um livro: você tem 15 erros aqui.
598	That is how he knew.	Era assim que ele sabia.
599	How many errors had crept into the books.	Quantos erros haviam entrado nos livros.
